s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt with 325ml warm water into a soft dough. Prove 1 hour, roll 2cm thick and cut into 12 squares. Fry at 175C for 2 minutes a side until puffed and golden. Serve warm with 60g butter and golden syrup.

Mix 420g creamed corn, 200g corn kernels, 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 3 sliced spring onions. Fry heaped tablespoons in oil for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain and serve hot with 125ml sweet chilli sauce.

m.note: Alamein, who'd rather be called Shogun
m.how: Season 1.2kg pork shoulder well. Line a deep roasting tin with cabbage leaves, add the pork, 600g kūmara, 600g pumpkin and 400g potatoes in chunks, then cover with more cabbage and wrap tightly in foil. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until the pork falls apart.

w.how: Heat 100g sugar and 2 tbsp golden syrup until bubbling and golden, about 4 minutes. Take off the heat, whisk in 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and pour onto baking paper to set. Smash into small pieces and fold through 1L slightly softened vanilla ice cream, then refreeze 1 hour.

d.how: Blend 600ml cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 4 tbsp lime cordial until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve straight away with straws.
